description: This file contains utility functions for object detection, including image preprocessing, bounding box correction, Non-Max Suppression, decoding model outputs, evaluation metrics like mean Average Precision (mAP), and supporting functions for bounding box overlap and softmax. It is used in a deep learning-based object detection pipeline, specifically tailored for YOLO model post-processing and evaluation.

methods.name: _sigmoid(x)
methods.description: Applies the sigmoid function to input x.

methods.name: makedirs(path)
methods.description: Creates directory at specified path if it does not exist.

methods.name: evaluate(model, generator, iou_threshold, obj_thresh, nms_thresh, net_h=416, net_w=416, save_path=None)
methods.description: Evaluates a dataset using the specified model, calculating mAP scores for each class.

methods.name: correct_yolo_boxes(boxes, image_h, image_w, net_h, net_w)
methods.description: Adjusts bounding box coordinates to match original image dimensions.

methods.name: do_nms(boxes, nms_thresh)
methods.description: Performs Non-Max Suppression to remove duplicate detections.

methods.name: decode_netout(netout, anchors, obj_thresh, net_h, net_w)
methods.description: Decodes the raw output of the neural network into bounding boxes.

methods.name: preprocess_input(image, net_h, net_w)
methods.description: Preprocesses input images for the model (resizing and normalizing).

methods.name: get_yolo_boxes(model, images, net_h, net_w, anchors, obj_thresh, nms_thresh)
methods.description: Generates bounding boxes from model predictions for input images.

methods.name: compute_overlap(a, b)
methods.description: Calculates the overlap between bounding boxes.

methods.name: compute_ap(recall, precision)
methods.description: Computes average precision from recall and precision curves.

methods.name: _softmax(x, axis=-1)
methods.description: Calculates the softmax of input array along specified axis.

ctags.name: evaluate
ctags.signature: (model, generator, iou_threshold, obj_thresh, nms_thresh, net_h=416, net_w=416, save_path=None)

ctags.name: get_yolo_boxes
ctags.pattern: /^def get_yolo_boxes(model, images, net_h, net_w, anchors, obj_thresh, nms_thresh):$/
ctags.signature: (model, images, net_h, net_w, anchors, obj_thresh, nms_thresh)
